entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.learning_activity: (a) Explain the principles, theories and concepts of current electricity (direct and alternating current and electrical networks)
teaching_learning_activities: Brainstorming: Guide students in groups to brainstorm on the applications of current electricity in their environment
Multimedia approach: Guide students to utilise interactive digital sources to explore the hands-on activities to explain the principles, theories and concepts of current electricity
Practical work: Guide students to explore on principles, theories and concepts of current electricity through hands-on activities
entries.assessment: Principles, theories and concepts of current electricity are clearly explained
entries.references: TIE, Physics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.learning_activity: (b) Explore the basic tenets of electromagnetism (electromagnetic force, induction and electromagnetic waves)
teaching_learning_activities: Group discussion: Facilitate group discussions for students to share their experiences on the basic tenets of electromagnetism and ask them some questions related to those concepts
Multimedia approach: Use interactive computer simulations and animations to provide a virtual environment for students to explore and manipulate variables related to electromagnetism
Hands-on experiments: Conduct hands-on experiments that demonstrate the principles of electromagnetism
entries.assessment: Principles underlying the phenomenon of electromagnetism are correctly explored
entries.references: TIE, Physics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
entries.learning_activity: (c) Explore the basic tenets of electronics and telecommunication (band theory, semiconductors, transistors, logic gates and satellites)
teaching_learning_activities: Flipped classroom: Assign students some activities to visit nearby small workshops for learning about different electronic components and devices in which they are used
Cooperative learning: Guide the students to share their experiences and understanding on the basic tenets of electronics and telecommunication
Project work: Facilitate students to do projects using concepts, theories, principles and laws in the field of electronics and telecommunication to develop prototype devices

Multimedia approach: Guide students by utilizing interactive digital sources to explore the hands-on activities which will enable the students to describe the concepts and principles related to electronics and telecommunication
entries.assessment: Concepts and principles related to electronics and telecommunication are correctly described
entries.references: TIE, Physics for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
